title: Pureger
tagline: Burger restaurant brand running its ordering experience on the Clyx Order platform.
overview: Pureger is a restaurant brand using Clyx Order's white-label ordering system for both its web ordering flow and dedicated Flutter app, giving it a branded ordering experience without building infrastructure from scratch.
problem: Pureger needed a branded, commission-free way for customers to order online and through a mobile app, without the cost of building a custom backend from zero.
solution: I configured Pureger as a tenant on the Clyx Order platform, built its branded web ordering flow, and adapted the shared Flutter app shell with Pureger's menu, pricing, and branch data.
architecture: Runs on the shared Clyx Order Laravel API with tenant-scoped data, a dedicated web storefront at clyxorder.com/pureger, and a Flutter app instance pointing at the same backend with Pureger-specific theming.
features: Branch selection with location-aware menu and delivery availability
Full cart, checkout, and order tracking flow
Branded storefront distinct from the base Clyx Order experience
Shared backend with other Clyx Order tenants, no duplicated infrastructure
challenges: Applying brand-specific theming on top of a shared codebase without forking the app
Coordinating menu structure so it fit both the generic platform schema and Pureger's actual product catalog
lessonsLearned: Building the first tenant on a multi-tenant platform is where you find every hardcoded assumption in the original design
futureImprovements: Loyalty and repeat-order incentives specific to the Pureger brand
In-app promotions tied to specific branches
results: Live ordering experience for a real restaurant brand, both on web and mobile
